model.detach_property_set.description: Detaches a property set from an object.

BehaviourLaw.description: How the stress in a material follows its strain.

Material.description: A substance that elements are made of, such as a concrete or steel grade (MAT-01). Its behaviour law says how it responds to strain. Each property value cites the document and clause it comes from (REP-05, ADR 0018); a material gives only the properties its category uses (ADR 0019).

alpha_cc.description: Coefficient αcc for long-term effects on the concrete compressive strength, to the recommended values.

alpha_cc_fr.description: Coefficient αcc for long-term effects on the concrete compressive strength, to the French national annex.

density.description:
Mass per unit volume, in kg/m³.

In kg/m³.

design_code.description: The design code the properties follow, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004`.

e0_05.description:
Timber fifth-percentile modulus of elasticity parallel to the grain, E0,05.

In Pa.

e0_mean.description:
Timber mean modulus of elasticity parallel to the grain, E0,mean.

In Pa.

e_modulus.description:
Modulus of elasticity; for concrete, the secant modulus Ecm.

In Pa.

eps_c2.description: Concrete compressive strain at the peak of the parabola-rectangle diagram, εc2, as a ratio.

eps_c3.description: Concrete compressive strain at the end of the rising branch of the bilinear diagram, εc3, as a ratio.

eps_cu2.description: Concrete ultimate compressive strain of the parabola-rectangle diagram, εcu2, as a ratio.

eps_cu3.description: Concrete ultimate compressive strain of the bilinear diagram, εcu3, as a ratio.

eps_u.description: Steel strain at maximum load: εu for structural steel, εuk for reinforcement, as a ratio.

fc0_k.description:
Timber characteristic compressive strength parallel to the grain, fc,0,k.

In Pa.

fck.description:
Concrete characteristic cylinder compressive strength at 28 days, fck.

In Pa.

fck_cube.description:
Concrete characteristic cube compressive strength at 28 days, fck,cube.

In Pa.

fcm.description:
Concrete mean cylinder compressive strength at 28 days, fcm.

In Pa.

fctm.description:
Concrete mean axial tensile strength, fctm.

In Pa.

fk.description:
Masonry characteristic compressive strength, fk.

In Pa.

fm_k.description:
Timber characteristic bending strength, fm,k.

In Pa.

ft0_k.description:
Timber characteristic tensile strength parallel to the grain, ft,0,k.

In Pa.

fu.description:
Steel ultimate tensile strength: fu for structural steel, ftk for reinforcement.

In Pa.

fv_k.description:
Timber characteristic shear strength, fv,k.

In Pa.

fy.description:
Steel yield strength: fy for structural steel, fyk for reinforcement.

In Pa.

g_mean.description:
Timber mean shear modulus, Gmean.

In Pa.

gamma_c.description: Partial factor γc for concrete, persistent and transient situations, to the recommended values.

gamma_c_fr.description: Partial factor γc for concrete, persistent and transient situations, to the French national annex.

gamma_m.description: Partial factor γM for timber or masonry, to the recommended values.

gamma_m0.description: Partial factor γM0 for the resistance of steel cross-sections, to the recommended values.

gamma_m0_fr.description: Partial factor γM0 for the resistance of steel cross-sections, to the French national annex.

gamma_m1.description: Partial factor γM1 for the resistance of steel members to instability, to the recommended values.

gamma_m1_fr.description: Partial factor γM1 for the resistance of steel members to instability, to the French national annex.

gamma_m2.description: Partial factor γM2 for the resistance of steel cross-sections in tension to fracture, to the recommended values.

gamma_m2_fr.description: Partial factor γM2 for the resistance of steel cross-sections in tension to fracture, to the French national annex.

gamma_m_fr.description: Partial factor γM for timber or masonry, to the French national annex.

gamma_s.description: Partial factor γs for reinforcing steel, persistent and transient situations, to the recommended values.

gamma_s_fr.description: Partial factor γs for reinforcing steel, persistent and transient situations, to the French national annex.

k.description: Ratio k of the tensile strength to the yield strength, at least 1.

library_key.description: The key of the library grade the material was created from, such as `concrete/C30-37`. Unset: the material was created from scratch.

n.description: Exponent n of the parabola of the parabola-rectangle diagram.

name.description: The material's name, such as `C30/37` or `S355`.

poisson_ratio.description: Ratio of lateral to axial strain under axial load.

rho_k.description:
Timber characteristic density, ρk.

In kg/m³.

rho_mean.description:
Timber mean density, ρmean.

In kg/m³.

thermal_conductivity.description:
Thermal conductivity λ, in W/(m·K).

In W/(m·K).

thermal_expansion.description: Linear thermal expansion coefficient, per kelvin.

MaterialCategory.description: What a material is; it decides which properties it gives and which behaviour laws suit it.

MaterialOriginal.description: The library value of a material property that the user has since edited, kept with its source so that resetting the property restores it (MAT-02, ADR 0019). A material has at most one per property.

key.description: The name of the edited `Material` attribute, such as `fck`.

material.description: The material whose property was edited.

value.description: The library value, in the attribute's SI unit, with the document and clause it comes from.

ObjectId.description: The stable 128-bit identifier of an object, as an IFC GlobalId.

Site.description: The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

base_point_eastings.description:
Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame.

In m.

base_point_height.description:
Orthogonal height of the project base point.

In m.

base_point_northings.description:
Northing of the project base point.

In m.

crs_epsg.description: EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced.

grid_rotation.description:
Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise.

In rad.

scale.description: Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero.

survey_point_eastings.description:
Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point.

In m.

survey_point_height.description:
Orthogonal height of the survey point.

In m.

survey_point_northings.description:
Northing of the survey point.

In m.

Source.description: Where a value comes from: the document and clause it is taken from, or the user who entered it.
